# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components. Space and Tech Engineering LLP is an Indian drone electronics company with offices in India. It designs and sells the Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs and NAVSATE GPS modules for UAV and FPV builders.

Key facts:
- Offices: India (registered office and product development centre).
- Use cases: agriculture, survey and mapping, defence and industrial, FPV racing, education, startups.
- OEM and bulk orders: arup@spaceandtech-engineerings.com, +91 96657 17903.

## Product collections
- [Drone Flight Controllers in India](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/drone-flight-controllers.html): Compare Aazmuth, Exelr8 and other UAV and FPV flight controllers by firmware support, sensors and board layout.
- [AM32 Drone ESCs for UAV and FPV Builds](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/drone-escs.html): Compare AM32 electronic speed controllers, including 3–6S single and 4-in-1 ESCs and a high-current 6–12S option.
- [GPS Modules for UAV and FPV Drones](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/drone-gps-modules.html): Compare NAVSATE UAV GPS and NAVSATE Mini FPV GPS for drone builds that need position data.
- [FPV Drone Electronics and Components](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/fpv-drone-electronics.html): Browse FPV flight controllers, ESCs, GPS modules, ExpressLRS receivers and video transmitters by build requirement.
- [5.8 GHz FPV Video Transmitters](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/fpv-video-transmitters.html): Compare Space and Tech Engineering’s analog and digital 5.8 GHz FPV video transmitter product pages.

## Products
- [Aazmuth flight controller](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/aazmuth-flight-controller.html): Modular, triple-redundant STM32 H7 flight controller with 3 IMUs and 2 barometers on isolated buses.
- [Exelr8 FPV flight controller F7](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/exelr8-fpv-flight-controller-f7.html): F7 flight controller for light, fast FPV racing and freestyle builds.
- [Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-60a.html): 60A AM32 ESC for 3-6S LiPo builds. Handles heavy payloads such as sprayer drones.
- [NAVSATE GPS for UAVs](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-gps-for-uavs.html): UAV-tuned GPS module, tested on long flights, for position hold and waypoint missions.
- [NAVSATE mini for FPV drones](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-mini-gps.html): Compact NAVSATE GPS for FPV drones. Adds position data to small builds.
- [ELRS FPV radio receiver](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/elrs-fpv-receiver.html): ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver with ESP32, CRSF output and built-in TCXO for FPV aircraft.
- [4-in-1 ESC 80A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-4-in-1-esc-80a.html): Four-channel FPV ESC on one board with AM32 support, DShot and 3-6S input.
- [SATE-HIGH AMP ESC 200A 6-12S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-high-amp-esc.html): High-current single ESC with 200A continuous rating, 6S-12S input and AM32 support.
- [SATE-AIO Board](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-aio-board.html): All-in-one flight controller and 4-in-1 ESC board, up to 25A continuous, AM32 and DShot.
- [Kinetik Flight Controller](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/kinetik-flight-controller.html): Compact 5×5 cm FPV flight controller with dual Betaflight and ArduPilot support for versatile drone applications.

## Guides
- [How to choose a drone flight controller in India](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/guide-flight-controller-india.html): Learn how to pick a drone flight controller: MCU, IMU, firmware, UART count and size. A practical guide for Indian FPV and UAV builders.
- [AM32 ESC explained: how to choose the right amp rating](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/guide-am32-esc.html): What is an AM32 ESC? Understand AM32 firmware, DShot support, current ratings, 3-6S vs 6-12S, and how to size an ESC for your drone.
- [How to choose a GPS module for UAVs and FPV drones](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/guide-uav-gps-module.html): GPS and GNSS modules for drones explained: constellations, compass, update rate, antenna and return-to-home. Buying tips for India.
- [The FPV drone electronics stack explained](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/guide-fpv-drone-electronics-stack.html): Every part of an FPV drone stack explained: flight controller, ESC, receiver, VTX, GPS and power. A build guide for Indian pilots.
- [ExpressLRS (ELRS) receivers: what they are and how to choose](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/guide-elrs-receiver.html): ELRS receivers explained: 2.4 GHz vs 900 MHz, packet rate, telemetry, antenna and binding. Practical guide for FPV and long range drones.
- [Documentation, pinouts and calibration](https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs)
